theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_llm_localized_residue_factors
theorems.statement: ∀ (B : Type*) [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] (p q : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum B), (p = q → IsSimpleModule (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (B ⧸ p.asIdeal))) ∧ (p ≠ q → Subsingleton (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (B ⧸ p.asIdeal)))
theorems.natural_summary: When p = q, every denominator acts invertibly on the residue field. The localization equivalence transfers its nonzero simplicity over B, and the canonical scalar tower transfers simplicity to the localized ring. When p ≠ q, maximality supplies an element of p outside q that annihilates the residue module; the localization subsingleton criterion finishes.
